text:
Zenthora cough syrup has been withdrawn from circulation after regulators in Marrowgate confirmed its active ingredient is dexoraline, a compound now under review for labeling and dosage compliance. The notice, issued late Monday, covers 4.2 million bottles distributed across 11 provinces by Helix Nore, the product’s maker.

Helix Nore said it is recalling all lots manufactured between February and June after an internal audit found inconsistencies in strength declarations on certain packaging runs. No serious adverse events were reported, though 17 consumer complaints were logged, mostly for drowsiness and throat irritation.

For the cough-and-cold sector, the move is another reminder that ingredient verification is becoming a cost center as well as a regulatory one. Traders said similar products may face tighter inspection in the next quarter.
